title: Not a good value as a mattress.  It is comfortable as a topper.
text:
Not a good value as a mattress. It is comfortable as a topper.. This is a comfortable mattress topper. I wouldn't use it as just a mattress unless it's for a small space as in a camper where there just isn't room for a full size mattress.

Cons: The mattress didn't plump up to 5" as described. I would say it only fluffed up to 3".
The price is too high for a mattress topper. I wouldn't buy this to use as a mattress alone.

Pros: There was no bad odor. It was comfortable as a topper. I'm sure if used as a mattress in a sofa sleeper, it would be much more comfortable than those springy mattresses.
